positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCadence
positions.frame: what verification cadence and operational discipline define an actual recovery capability?
positions.why: src-1 mandates a monthly rehearsal schedule for Atlas rollbacks, while src-2 establishes the foundational operational principle that unverified rollback procedures do not constitute actual capability. Together, the directive and principle cohere around how organizational recovery readiness must be actively verified rather than nominally assumed.
